caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden figurine resembling a standing female figure. The figure is rendered in shades of brown, giving the appearance of carved wood. She has a simple, roughly oval head with short, stylized hair and prominent facial features including large, deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and a closed mouth. The figure’s neck is elongated, connecting to sloping shoulders and arms that hang down by her sides, ending in roughly shaped hands. She is dressed in a long-sleeved, ankle-length dress that is fitted at the waist and has a v-shaped neckline. The garment and the shoes, also rendered in the same wood-toned color, lack intricate details but have subtle shading to suggest form and depth. The background is plain and off-white, without any other objects or features. The overall appearance is geometric and stylized, with smooth contours and minimal surface detail.
title: Wooden Doll
